no.text: If you vote no, this change would not be made.
no.excerpt: If approved, the measure would amend provisions of the Berkeley City Charter pertaining to election administration and procedures and requirements affecting candidates, initiatives, referenda, and recalls, and other changes.
no.location: City Attorney's Impartial Analysis of Measure W, paragraph 2 (page 4)

fiscal.text: Raises the maximum public campaign financing funds usable for Fair Campaign Practices Commission and City staff administration and enforcement costs from $250,000 to $400,000, subject to cost of living adjustments.
fiscal.excerpt: Increase the maximum amount of public campaign financing funds which may be used for Berkeley Fair Campaign Practices Commission (“FCPC”) and City staff administrative and enforcement costs related to the public campaign financing program from $250,000 to $400,000, which is subject to cost of living adjustments.
fiscal.location: City Attorney's Impartial Analysis of Measure W, item 3 (page 4)
